spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2.
** Know
 that before states
 of falsity and states
 of truth were yet
 distinguished within
 the mind, a
 mediating Divine
 power
 proce
eding from the Lord
 was called
 forth. And
 afterward
 this
 power
 was directed
 into
 the condition
 of spiritual emptiness and interior
 de
solation —
 where
 no
 good
 or
 truth remained
 — so that it
 might purify whatever
 of
 wisdom
 had
 been held
 captive there
,
 and separate what belongs
 to ignor
ance from what belongs to enlight
enment.

**¶3
.** Before wisdom
 could
 be liberated from its
 captivity among
 sens
ory and
 natural things
 and asc
end through
 the successive
 degrees of the mind, the Divine
 as the origin
 of all spiritual life prepared
 for
 it doc
trinal forms
 capable
 of receiving
 and
 carrying
 truth
. These
 containing
 forms were fash
ioned so
 that wisdom
 might be refined
 within them and
 brought
 into heavenly arrangement
 according
 to Divine
 order.

**¶4.
** Before evil
 from
 self-love had multipl
ied and established its
 dominion within
 the proprium —
 the selfhood that
 claims
 life
 as
 its own — and
 before those
 governed
 by good and
 those governed by evil had
 been
 set
 apart from
 one
 another, the power
 of discernment from
 Divine
 truth was sent
 forth and
 made
 manifest
. The
 seat
 of this
 discernment was established within
 the living
 rational
 mind
, which is the medium between what
 is celestial and what is natural,
 so
 that judgment
 might be just
:
 so
 that there
,
 those
 who live
 from
 good and those who live from evil might
 be examined
 according to their interior states and
 separated
 from
 one another.

**¶6
.** Further
:
 before specific
 human
 dispositions had been brought into existence
, some
 were designated
 as those
 abundant
 in knowledges of truth and others
 as those de
stitute of them in
 the natural mind. And
 before spiritual
 death overt
akes
 those who
 will per
ish in
ward
ly, their course
 is already
 insc
ribed within
 the fixed arrangements of interior knowledges
 and the governing
 con
stellations of inherited
 disposition
 in
 the natural mind. These
 ruling
 tend
encies are appointed
 for them; within
 these
 dispos
itions are the
 origins
 of their spiritual
 life
. And their
 deep
est interior root
 is bound
 to
 these
 governing loves
,
 and
 they are comp
elled by them and brought to an
 im
partial disc
ernment corresponding exactly
 to their works and their evils.


**¶7.** Further
: before the present state of the church
 reaches
 its cons
ummation and the whole natural mind in
 which
 it
 dwelt
 is laid waste, the powers of Divine
 judgment that dismantle every
 false order
 were already
 appointed
 and prepared
 for that
 dissolution.

**¶8.
** And
 before the
 new spiritual
 state —
 the
 new church — could
 be established and brought
 to perfection and
 set
 in
 its
 proper
 boundaries
, the Divine power that builds
 from
 first principles was called forth
:
 the original
 forming
 intelligence
,
 together
 with the active
 Divine
 tru
ths that
 proceed from it, whose
 office
 it
 is to construct and bring into full
 beauty
 the new heavenly state.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Know that before night and day were differentiated in the universe, the Third [Am]bassador was summoned. And afterwards, he was sent to this void and outer waste that he might purify the light, and separate night and day from each other.

Before the light was released and freed and ascended through this zone, the Father of Life made beautiful for it the ships of light. He constructed them so that it might be purified in them, and be sculpted and fashioned in good order.

[Bef]ore Sin had multiplied and had made a kingdom in the flesh, before the acquitted and the condemn[ed] were set apart from each other, the Judge [w]as sent forth and revealed. His throne was created and placed [i]n the living atmosphere, so that he would be a just Judge, so that there the righteous and the sinners would be set apart and tested and separated from each other.

Again, [befo]re mankind had been engendered, some were named ['rich' and] others 'poor' on earth [and their fates were decreed] upon them. Before they die, they who will die are marked out by the stars and the signs of the zodiac in the sphere. They are appointed for them; in them are their births. And their root is bound up with their zodiacal signs; and they are compelled by them and brought to an equal judgement in accordance with their deeds and their sins.
Again, before the universe is dissolved, [and the] entire earth, the destroyers were appointed and instructed for its dissolution.

And before the ne[w] aeon was [built and] made be[auti]ful and marked out, [the] Great Builder [w]as summoned, the first architect and the angels who are with him, who would build and make beautiful the new aeon.
